# `factory/schemas.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › `schemas.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Defines Pydantic schemas for the output contracts of every agent in the software factory pipeline. Field descriptions are shipped to the model as part of the JSON schema and serve as instructions.

2,689 lines, shared by nearly everything.
